name: Reporting
description: Reporting authority — lets an agent read the evidence a gateway holds (tickets, approvals, mandates, records in the systems it connects) and write one report stored on that machine. Changes no system.
whatsNew: Protocol v0.7 wording: the scope schema replaces the context schema, and the required gate is the Mandate Owner. Limits and scope are unchanged.

read_access.description: Allow the agent to read tickets, approvals, mandates and the records in connected systems, to build a report

read_max_age_days.description: How far back the agent may read evidence for a report: tickets, approvals, mandates and records from the last N days, at most 366. Anything older is invisible to the agent and cannot enter a report or an export. Enforced locally by the gateway (reads carry no ticket); signed here so the window the owner approved is part of the mandate.

report_daily_max.description: Maximum times per day the agent may write or replace the report

report_count_daily.description: Running daily count of report writes
